note: READ-ONLY. `data/` is skipped because it holds only a sparse remnant: 52 of the 59 files tracked under it in origin/main are absent locally. Walking it would report a drive-state artifact as live-vs-sg8 drift. (An earlier version of this note said `data/` is a directory junction to D:. That was inherited from CLAUDE.md and is FALSE -- there is no reparse point anywhere in the project as of 2026-10-19.)
which_delta_to_reconcile_against: `delta` (EOL-normalised). `raw_delta` is kept only to show how much of the byte-level difference is line endings: .gitattributes forces LF in the repo blob so the integrity-hashed surfaces keep a stable sha256 across platforms, while the live working copy is CRLF. Reconciling against `raw_delta` would mean reading a list that is overwhelmingly noise.
